en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Chapter on the Surusuru Sound, 53.
The Training Rule on Licking the Bowl.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks ate scraping their bowls clean...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not eat scraping my bowl clean.
One must not eat scraping one's bowl clean.
Whoever, out of disrespect, eats by licking the bowl commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it was unintentional.
for one who does not know,
When only a small amount remains, he gathers it together, licks it clean, and eats it;
[this is permissible] in times of distress or for one who is insane.
"For one who is a first offender.
The third training rule is concluded.
